going home.source: When he was at high school (William Knibb Memorial High) almost every evening he used to hang out in my video store before going home so I have always watched his progress over the years.

going home.source: In Konyokonyo and Jebel Markets in Juba, many foreign traders said they are going home for Christmas, and then wait till the referendum exercise is completed before returning.
going home.target: Kwenye masoko ya Konyokonyo na Jebel huko Juba, wafanyabiashara wengi wakigeni walisema wanaenda nyumbani kwa sikukuu ya Krismas, na kisha watangoja mpaka zoezi la kura ya maoni limalizike ndipo warudi.

go home.source: By 1:30 I'm having lunch from Subway with the girls, then go back to work and leave at 4:30, go home, relax, take a shower, get dressed, wait for the driver to take me to the Chinese place since I invited the girls out.

go home.source: And yet members of the opposition are refusing to go home quietly.
go home.target: Na bado wanachama wa upinzani wanakataa kurudi makwao kwa utulivu.

go to school.source: Xiao Qing carrying a placard stands at the gate of Gongbei Xiawan Primary School and she is so anxious to go to school like other little boys and girls.
go to school.target: Binti huyo, Xiao Qing, akiwa amebeba bango husimama katika lango la kuingia katika Shule ya Msingi Gongbei Xiawan huku akiwa amejawa na hamu tele ya kujiunga na shule kama wanavyofanya watoto wengine wa kike na kiume.

go to school.source: In Indonesia, women are considered successful not from what they have achieved, but from their husbands, how many kids they can deliver and how fat their kids are and where their kids go to school.
go to school.target: Katika Indonesia wanawake wanaangaliwa mafanikio yao si kwa yale waliyoyafanya, bali kutokana na waume zao, ni watoto wangapi wanaweza kuzaa na watoto wao wana siha kiasi gani, na watoto wanasoma shule zipi.

come back.source: I don't mean to say that the West is not greedy, that capitalism would not come back with a savage fury if they let it.
come back.target: Sina maana kwamba nchi za magharibi hazina tamaa, kwamba mabepari hawatatushukia kwa hasira ikiwa watapata mwanya.  Hapana.

come back.source: We talked back and forth a few minutes and finally he wanted 50 more CFA (like 10 cents) and I wouldn't pay it and so I grabbed a plastic bag and bagged my own apples and left the money on his cart while we both laughed and I walked away saying thank you and that I would come back next time (this is a common way to leave a conversation in Cameroon - saying thanks, next time).”
come back.target: Tukazungumza kwa kuvutana dakika chache na mwishowe akataka CFA50 zaidi (kama senti 10) na sikuweza kulipa na ndipo nikachukua mfuko wangu na kupakia matunda yangu na kuacha hela kwenye mkokoteni wake wakati sote tukicheka na kuondoka huku nikisema asante na kwamba ningerudi wakati mwingine (hii ni namna iliyozoeleka ya kumaliza mazungumzo nchini Cameroon -kusema asante, wakati mwingine).”

look for.source: We go to the Chinese and the Indians and look for models, but we don't want to look at their conditions and methods of operating.

look for.source: Most of the times, they will tell you that ‘Sorry come next month, give us time to look for it'.  Now Imagine a person is coming from Nsanje to the AG's office in Blantyre; he comes again as per the arrangement and is told that he should wait for another week, very frustrating isn't it?

pay attention.source: In contrast, the conflict in Congo seems like just another tragedy on a cursed continent that people don't pay attention to anymore because these kinds of tragedies are so frequent.
pay attention.target: Tofauti na mgogoro wa Kongo ambao unaonekana kana kwamba ni moja tu ya madhila mengine yanayotokea kwenye bara lililolaaniwa ambalo watu hawalitilii maanani tena kwa sababu madhila ya namna hii hutokea mara kwa mara.

pay attention.source: Few international media outlets pay attention to the situation here.
pay attention.target: Vyombo vichache vya habari vya kimataifa vinatilia maanani hali ilivyo hapa.

get back.source: The fishmongers are yelling to get back to work.
I even manage to keep down my anxiety not being able to get back to Jehanne by noticing that the one-storied buildings held out the tremors.

#lightupnigeria so that her 140million nigerians can say goodnight and really look forward to having one

take care.source: She fell sick with a high fever and wasn't in a state to take care of their baby girl but her husband refused to take paid leave or come home earlier than usual.
